faultMatrix.name: Power loss / process crash mid-reconcile
faultMatrix.injectionMechanism: Kill xpanel-agent with SIGKILL (or phase hook crash) during each stage: render, stage, test, activate, reload, verify.
faultMatrix.expectedRecovery: On restart, journal recovery either finishes or rolls back to the previous active generation; zero half-written configs or orphaned systemd units.

faultMatrix.name: Disk exhaustion (ENOSPC)
faultMatrix.injectionMechanism: Mount a small loopback filesystem or inject ENOSPC on /var/lib/xpanel, /var/backups, or /tmp during state write, backup creation, or upgrade staging.
faultMatrix.expectedRecovery: Operation aborts cleanly with a clear error code, cleans up its staging directory, and leaves the active generation and state intact.

faultMatrix.name: Corrupt or invalid config generation
faultMatrix.injectionMechanism: Inject an invalid directive into a staged Nginx, Apache/OLS, PHP-FPM, PowerDNS, or Postfix/Dovecot file before the stage test phase.
faultMatrix.expectedRecovery: Staged syntax validator (nginx -t, apache2ctl -t, php-fpm -t, pdnsutil check-all-zones, postconf, dovecot -n) rejects the candidate; live service is never reloaded.

faultMatrix.name: Service reload failure or post-reload health check timeout
faultMatrix.injectionMechanism: Simulate a port bind conflict or systemd reload failure during the reload/verify phase.
faultMatrix.expectedRecovery: Reconciler automatically restores previous generation files and reloads affected services back to a healthy state, marking the candidate generation rolled_back.

faultMatrix.name: Upstream dependency failure
faultMatrix.injectionMechanism: Simulate Let's Encrypt rate-limit/HTTP-01 challenge failure, MariaDB/PostgreSQL connection rejection, or Rspamd unavailability.
faultMatrix.expectedRecovery: Existing TLS certificate remains active; database and mail operations fail gracefully with actionable diagnostics and retryable job state.

faultMatrix.name: Backup destination failure
faultMatrix.injectionMechanism: Drop S3/SFTP connection mid-upload, flip a byte in a backup chunk, or supply an invalid decryption passphrase.
faultMatrix.expectedRecovery: Upload retries with exponential backoff; restore halts during pre-restore SHA-256/AEAD verification before touching any live account file or database.
